SELECT id, name, status, organizer, contact_phone, venue, registration_start, registration_end, competition_date, schedule_id, sign_sheet_id, player_list_id, event_id, result_id, notice_id, appeal_id, create_time, update_time FROM sports_meeting WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT id, name, status, organizer, contact_phone, venue, registration_start, registration_end, competition_date, schedule_id, sign_sheet_id, player_list_id, event_id, result_id, notice_id, appeal_id, create_time, update_time FROM sports_meeting WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR organizer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR venue LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR competition_date LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY create_time DESC
